findings.evidence: `private def blockSign (ε : V → k) : Matrix (V × m) (V × m) k := diagonal fun p ↦ ε p.1`. The proofs use only `ext` and `simp` and nothing about graphs or zigzag algebras.
findings.fix: Restate both with `diagonal (fun p ↦ ε p.1)` in place of the private `blockSign`, move them to a general matrix/Kronecker file and make them public. `blockSign` can stay a local helper or be dropped.
findings.issue: `blockSign_mul_single_kronecker` and `single_kronecker_mul_blockSign` are private. Once `blockSign` is unfolded to `diagonal`, they are general facts about Mathlib's `diagonal`, `single` and Kronecker product: the diagonal matrix `diagonal (fun p ↦ ε p.1)` scales `single a b 1 ⊗ₖ X` by `ε a` on the left and `ε b` on the right. They are general infrastructure kept `private`.

Relocate and export the Kronecker/diagonal lemmas, and derive the Liu–Wang walk lemma from `fst_eq_snd_of_mem_support_single`.
